name: 320x240@200 (240 fps actual) - production
note: Validated: 7209 frames / 30.01 s = 240.3 fps, zero drops. Nyquist 120 Hz covers the 78-98 Hz HTR band. Recommended.

name: 640x480@120 (~100 fps actual) - high spatial detail
note: MJPEG encoder saturates near 100 fps at VGA. Nyquist 50 Hz is BELOW the HTR band - the 90 Hz oscillation will alias. Use only for pose-model training frames or non-HTR scoring.

name: 640x480@100 - VGA baseline
note: Same aliasing caveat as above. 3002 frames / 30 s verified.

name: 160x120@400 - maximum temporal fidelity
note: Experimental. Very coarse spatially; blob tracking may fail on a 15-20 cm arena. Probe before trusting.

name: 320x240@100 - YUV uncompressed
note: No MJPEG compression artifacts, but limited to 100 fps and ~6x the disk rate. Aliases the HTR band.
